retrievalProfile.description: A warm, sepia-toned close-up portrait framed by a double gold border with tall, condensed yellow serif typography in the upper left corner.
triggerTerms: condensed serif display text on portrait
excludeWhen: modern high-contrast black and white is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, slightly angled headshot of a male subject with a beard, rendered in warm sepia tones. The composition is enclosed in a black square frame featuring a thin double-line gold border. Typography is stacked in the top-left quadrant using a highly condensed, high-contrast serif font in a muted yellow hue.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm sepia tones contrasting with a stark black outer frame
Verticality of condensed typography echoing the subject's facial structure
Geometric rigidity of the double border containing the organic textures of hair and knitwear
Top-left text placement balancing the subject's rightward gaze
coreInvariants: Sepia or warm monochromatic color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Close-up head and shoulders, filling approximately 80% of the frame, angled slightly to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bright yellow display text in the upper left.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright text in the top left, moves down to the subject's eyes, and follows the beard line to the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; limited to the corners around the head and the black border area.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with high value in the highlights; deep shadows provide form.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used in different scales for title and artist name.

preserve: High contrast between thick and thin strokes

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the extreme condensation and high contrast serifs.
Provides the necessary high-contrast vertical elegance.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sepia-toned studio portrait of a man with a beard wearing a textured knit sweater, framed by a black square with a thin double gold line border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase text in the top-left corner using a tall, condensed yellow serif font, stacking the words vertically.

verificationChecks: Is the border a double gold line?
Is the text condensed and high-contrast?
Is the text placed in the top-left corner?

adjustableVariables: Thickness of the gold border lines
Exact shade of yellow for text
mustRedesign: Specific artist name and song titles
Exact facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure text does not overlap the subject's main facial features
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Sepia Tone + Double Gold Border + Top-Left Condensed Serif Typography = Classic Artist Cover
